## Context

Both DL-002 (fixed 500ms) and DL-004 (fixed 1000ms) had retry-storm
failure modes. Need backoff with jitter.

## Decision

Exponential backoff (base 200ms, cap 30s) with full jitter, max 5
attempts.

## Consequences

Worst-case latency ~60s, but no observed retry storms in load tests.
Implementation moves to a dedicated `retry.ts` helper.
